title: 选项颜色：声明了九个色系以外的颜色名（如 teal、amber）时界面静默显示为中性灰，应在保存时提示或给出映射（接 #36882）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S3 of the seat's contract-tier L2 on PR #37427 (#36882), record 7182916794, verdict 7182932149; the seat asked the owning zone to card it. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (with the parent) · reach: any author who declares a select option `color` that is neither one of the nine semantic families nor a hex, once #36882 ships · evidence: L2 S3; os-dev report 7182745430 (out-of-scope note: no platform or example producer declares one today).

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#36882 之后，选项颜色只认九个色系名或十六进制色。写了 teal、amber 这类名字的，界面会悄悄显示成灰色，作者不知道写错了。改成保存时提示，或者把常见颜色名映射到最近的色系。
- 谁受益：给选项配颜色的搭建者。
- 不做会怎样：写了颜色却显示灰色，没有任何提示。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- After #36882 an option `color` outside the nine families and not a hex renders neutral with no signal (before, the value hash coloured it).
- Pick one and state why in the PR: (a) refuse or warn at save on an out-of-family colour name, naming the nine families; or (b) map the common CSS names (teal, amber, …) to the nearest family. Option (a) is a narrowing and carries its own declaration.

## Acceptance

- An out-of-family colour name no longer renders neutral silently; a pin for it and for a declared family name.

## Order

After PR #37427 merges.

Blocked-by: #36882

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5).
Dedupe: open issues for "teal amber option color" and "out-of-family colour" return none.
